title: Disentangling Optimization Scale from Preference Scale in DPO
abstract: arXiv:2608.27032v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) is a widely used objective for aligning language models from preference data, with the coefficient $\beta$ commonly interpreted as controlling the KL constraint to a reference policy. We show that $\beta$ entangles two distinct roles: it governs the effective inverse preference-noise scale and simultaneously rescales the optimization dynamics, coupling this scale with the effective step size. As a consequence, at a fixed learning rate the achieved policy deviation is non-monotone in $\beta$: it vanishes in a dead zone at small $\beta$, reaches a peak at an intermediate value, and decreases again for larger $\beta$. Moreover, standard DPO loss values are not comparable across $\beta$: runs with nearly identical loss curves can differ several-fold in KL divergence from the reference model. translated_title: 解耦DPO中的优化尺度与偏好尺度
translated_abstract: 直接偏好优化（DPO）是一种广泛用于从偏好数据中对齐语言模型的目标函数，其中系数β通常被解释为控制对参考策略的KL约束。我们表明β纠缠了两个不同的作用：它既控制有效的逆偏好噪声尺度，同时又重新缩放优化动态，将该尺度与有效步长耦合。因此，在固定学习率下，所达到的策略偏差在β上非单调：它在小的β下消失于死区，在中间值达到峰值，并在更大的β下再次减小。此外，标准DPO损失值在β之间不可比较：具有几乎相同损失曲线的运行，其与参考模型的KL散度可能相差数倍。这种纠缠模糊了β的作用，增加了对超参数选择的敏感性，并使比较复杂化。
tldr: 本文发现DPO中的β系数将偏好噪声尺度和优化步长纠缠在一起，导致策略偏差随β非单调变化，且损失值在β间不可比，从而揭示了β作用的新理解。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that the β coefficient in DPO entangles preference-noise scale with optimization step size, causing non-monotonic policy deviation in β and incomparable loss values across β.
